description: This file defines the CanvasFileWatcher class, a final class that implements SimpleFileWatcherOwner protocol. It encapsulates a file watcher object configured to monitor a specific URL path for changes, and triggers a callback when changes are detected.

classes.name: CanvasFileWatcher
classes.description: A final class that monitors file changes at a specified URL, utilizing a coalescing FSEvents watcher to invoke callbacks on change events.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes a CanvasFileWatcher with a URL and a change callback, setting up the internal watcher accordingly.
